# Narender Charan, SEO and GEO Specialist

> Narender Charan is a Web3 content strategist and SEO/GEO specialist with 8 years of experience building organic audiences, ranking content on Google, and getting brands cited in AI-generated answers. He is available for freelance and full-time remote work globally.

Tagline: I build things. I rank them.

## About

Narender Charan specialises in SEO (search engine optimisation) and GEO (generative engine optimisation) for crypto protocols, blockchain infrastructure, SaaS companies, fintech brands, and any organisation that wants to rank on Google and get cited by AI systems like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

He has been working remotely since 2017 from a small town in the Himalayas, India.

## Offers

There are two paid offers, and every engagement starts with the same free consultation call.

- **Done-for-you SEO + GEO**: keyword and entity research, content architecture and topical authority, technical SEO and schema, GEO structuring so the site is retrieved and cited by AI search, and monthly reporting against real queries.
- **Coaching**: for teams that want to run search in house. SEO and AEO fundamentals taught properly, blog pipelines from brief to publish, tooling setup and workflows, and live reviews of the team's output.

The **free website audit is bundled into the consultation call** rather than sold separately. It covers technical and on-page review, content and keyword gap analysis, GEO readiness, a report of which AI crawlers already read the site (measured with Kymo), and a prioritised action list. The findings are the prospect's to keep regardless of whether paid work follows. There is no standalone audit page.

Book the free consultation call and audit: https://cal.com/narender/intro

## Products he owns

- **Kymo** (https://kymo.in): web analytics that tracks both audiences, humans on your site and the AI crawlers reading it. The instrument behind RemoteStack. Live product with paid subscribers.
- **RemoteStack** (https://remotestack.in): an AI-assisted remote job board built solo, ranked first for its own name on a brand new domain.
- **manali.today** (https://manali.today): live snow and road conditions for Manali, Himachal Pradesh.

## Newsletter

**Building at 2,050m** (https://narendercharan.substack.com) is an indie build log rather than an SEO newsletter. It covers building tiny internet businesses from a Himalayan town: ideas, launches, failures, and the hunt for the first paid customer.

## Homepage structure

https://narender.xyz/ runs in this order: navigation, hero, the two services as illustrated chhatri arch panels, results (case rows for Kymo, RemoteStack, manali.today, Velar and Panther Academy plus a condensed experience timeline), a GEO-focused FAQ, and a footer carrying the newsletter signup. The page publishes JSON-LD for Person (including the products he owns), ProfessionalService with an offer catalogue and the free consultation offer, and FAQPage.
